title: Better With Autostack
description: BTA mod that adds the functionality of autostacking items in a chest when pressing Shift + middle mouse button.
body:
If you press Shift+Middle mouse button on any cell of a chest or inventory, matching items will be quickly transferred from one container to another.

Tools, armor, torches and arrows aren't moving.

![Autostack in action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56b0aaf11e8a43d527a6fe3352f849beced933cb.gif)

Enjoy!
